cases.case_id: G2-03 0.1mm suppression + G1-04 zero/negative-zero + detail gate
cases.instrumentation: World standard mode, Show linear on. Exact positions were injected through !!gphMeasure.setMeasure(LINE), the same callback the EDG distance action calls. The draw gates were evaluated on the resulting runtime offsets with the exact expressions used by GPHDIMENSION.draw(): offset.between(-0.1mm, 0.1mm) and int(sum of offsets) ne int(length). From = E 10000mm N 10000mm U 15000mm, dN = +2000, dU = +1000 unless stated.

cases.note: 10000.1 - 10000 lands just above 0.1 in binary, so the nominally inclusive boundary draws the component.

cases.rows: Distance 2000mm / Offset E 0mm / Offset N 2000mm / Offset U 0mm / Direction N
cases.note: single positive axis component: with Show linear on, only the direct line is drawn; the component breakdown is skipped
single negative axis component: breakdown is drawn (asymmetric with the positive case)

cases.rows: Distance 5000mm / Offset E 3000mm / Offset N 4000mm / Offset U 0mm / Direction N 36.8699 E

observation.tolerance_rule: A component is suppressed when offset.between(-0.1mm, 0.1mm) is TRUE (inclusive in exact arithmetic). Because the offset is a floating-point difference of World coordinates, inputs that are nominally exactly 0.1mm apart may land on either side; 0.09mm is reliably suppressed and 0.11mm reliably drawn. Tests must assert strictly inside/outside the band.
observation.formatting: The distance format prints 2 decimals and trims trailing zeros (0.09mm, 0.1mm, 2000mm, 2236.07mm). Values that round to zero print as 0mm with no sign, including -0.004mm and -0.00001mm.
observation.detail_gate: With Show linear on and detail on, the orthogonal breakdown is only drawn when int(offsetE + offsetN + offsetU) ne int(length). A single positive axis-aligned component therefore shows only the direct line, while the negative counterpart and any multi-axis case show the breakdown. With Show linear off (orthogonalOnly) the breakdown is always drawn.

cases.web_decision: 2026-09-12: replicate the observed gate as-is. src/measurement/aids/worldDistanceAidPlan.ts shouldDrawWorldAxisBreakdown() = !showDirect || trunc(sumMm) !== trunc(lengthMm) (1e-6 mm snap before truncation); buildWorldDistanceAidPlan applies it after showOrthogonal and useXeokitMeasurementTools passes the real Show linear flag. Covered by worldDistanceAidPlan.test.ts 'E3D 3.1 runtime golden G2-03' cases.

observation.collinear_rule: Exactly collinear picks (0deg or 180deg, or a coincident second point) cannot build the arc plane; radius3PointsNoError returns an unset ARC and the form path setMeasure(unset) raises alert.error 'An angular dimension could not be constructed from the data selected' and keeps the previous dimension (form code read, not invoked). The GPHANGLEDIMENSION.draw() 'Angle 0' text branch is therefore unreachable from the three-point pick flow.
observation.range_rule: Reported angles are always the minor angle in [0,180]; the arc plane normal is chosen from the pick order (right-hand from first to second), so a clockwise second point flips the orientation instead of producing a reflex angle.
observation.precision: Near-collinear inputs are accepted; 0.1deg and 179.9deg format as 0.1 and 179.9 with the default angle format.

cases.verdict: 0deg and 180deg are rejected by the kernel before the form; minor-angle-only semantics and near-collinear acceptance are confirmed.

limitations: The runtime uses a repaired shadow installation and injected startup patches; compatibility claims are scoped to the recorded hashes.
Mouse picks were visually targeted. Exact picked feature IDs were not exported by the product UI.
PML instrumentation read current form objects and invoked their public callbacks; it did not edit model database elements.

The 2026-09-12 10:xx round ran while the E3D main window was minimised/occluded behind the user's active desktop session: results were captured through the same EDG actions and form callbacks the UI uses, alert-raising paths were not invoked, and the 3D-view screenshots for G2-03 and G4-02 were taken with PrintWindow on the occluded window (printwindow-capture.ps1) instead of a foreground desktop capture.
Shortest, Snap ambiguity (G7), the Keep lifecycle sequences (G2-04/05) and the two-graphic angle entry remain gated.
